description: Small zh<->en evaluation set for the simultaneous-interpretation skill benchmark. References are natural human translations. Sentences stress numbers, dates, names, negation, and conditionals.

pairs.source: The board will approve the 2026 budget next quarter.
pairs.reference: 董事会将在下个季度批准2026年的预算。

pairs.source: If revenue does not grow, we will not expand the team in March.
pairs.reference: 如果收入没有增长，我们三月份就不会扩充团队。

pairs.source: Sarah said the launch is delayed by two weeks due to a supply issue.
pairs.reference: Sarah说由于供应问题，发布推迟了两周。

pairs.source: Our Q3 profit rose 15 percent compared with last year.
pairs.reference: 我们第三季度的利润比去年增长了15%。

pairs.source: Please review the contract before the meeting on Friday afternoon.
pairs.reference: 请在周五下午开会之前审阅这份合同。

pairs.source: The new model reduces latency, but it requires more memory.
pairs.reference: 新模型降低了延迟，但需要更多内存。

pairs.source: We cannot ship the product unless the safety test passes.
pairs.reference: 除非安全测试通过，否则我们无法发货。

pairs.source: John will present the results at 9 a.m. tomorrow in Room 204.
pairs.reference: John将于明天上午9点在204房间汇报结果。

pairs.source: The discount applies only to orders over five hundred dollars.
pairs.reference: 该折扣仅适用于超过五百美元的订单。

pairs.source: Honestly, I think we should delay the decision until the data is clear.
pairs.reference: 老实说，我认为我们应该等数据明确之后再做决定。

pairs.source: She did not agree with the proposal, and she asked for more details.
pairs.reference: 她不同意这个提案，并要求提供更多细节。

pairs.source: The server crashed twice last night, so we rolled back the update.
pairs.reference: 服务器昨晚崩溃了两次，所以我们回滚了更新。

pairs.source: 如果明天下雨，会议就改到下周一。
pairs.reference: If it rains tomorrow, the meeting will be moved to next Monday.

pairs.source: 我们第二季度的销售额增长了百分之二十。
pairs.reference: Our second-quarter sales grew by 20 percent.

pairs.source: 张总说这个项目预算不能超过一百万。
pairs.reference: Mr. Zhang said the project budget cannot exceed one million.

pairs.source: 除非客户确认，否则我们不会开始生产。
pairs.reference: Unless the client confirms, we will not start production.

pairs.source: 请在周三之前把报告发给我。
pairs.reference: Please send me the report before Wednesday.

pairs.source: 新版本修复了三个严重的漏洞，但还没有完全测试。
pairs.reference: The new version fixed three critical bugs, but it has not been fully tested.

pairs.source: 他没有反对这个计划，只是希望再等一周。
pairs.reference: He did not oppose the plan; he just wanted to wait one more week.

pairs.source: 我们的团队将于五月十号搬到新办公室。
pairs.reference: Our team will move to the new office on May 10th.

pairs.source: 这次折扣只针对老客户，新客户不适用。
pairs.reference: This discount is only for existing customers and does not apply to new ones.

pairs.source: 说实话，我觉得这个方案的风险太高了。
pairs.reference: Honestly, I think the risk of this plan is too high.

pairs.source: 李娜负责市场，王强负责技术。
pairs.reference: Li Na is in charge of marketing, and Wang Qiang is in charge of technology.

pairs.source: 如果价格再涨，我们就考虑换供应商。
pairs.reference: If the price rises again, we will consider switching suppliers.
